card.does: Opens and closes a gap in a power line.
card.gives: Gives: a way to stop and start the power.
card.needs: Needs: a place in a power line, between the battery pack and a part.
card.popularMechanics: A light switch on a wall opens and closes a gap in the same way.

failureModes.cardLine: Across the battery pack: closing it drains the pack fast.
failureModes.hint: This switch joins plus straight to minus
failureModes.teachingNote: A switch wired straight across the battery pack joins plus to minus when it closes, so closing it makes a short circuit instead of turning a part on.

failureModes.cardLine: Not in the loop: pressing it changes nothing.
failureModes.hint: This switch is not in the power line
failureModes.teachingNote: A switch stops and starts only the loop it sits in. Wired off to one side of the loop, pressing it changes nothing.
